description: Resolve print colour pair notation (4/4, 4/1, 4+4) into per-surface colour bindings for a given product. The number is a COUNT OF SEPARATIONS, not a colour: it is resolved by searching the combinations this product's envelope actually supports whose colorChannelCount sums to that number. Returns one of three outcomes per surface — a deterministic binding, `needs_disambiguation` with the candidate combinations, or `invalid_for_template` when no combination is possible. IMPORTANT: when `needs_disambiguation` is returned you MUST put its `question` to the user and never infer the answer yourself. '1' is black on some products and a named spot colour on others; guessing gives two different products the same identity. Do not fingerprint an unresolved configuration.

setup.description: Optional setup-model URI/path (e.g. 'printing/configurations/setup-models/folded-sheet/tri-fold') so the surfaces match the fold. Required for products with several setups.

surfaces.description: Optional surface slugs in notation order. Without them the faces come from 'setup' (or the product's only setup): flat-sheet front/back, folded-sheet outside/inside, roll face/back (SD-0083).

name: ptpge_resolve_color_notation
title: Resolve colour notation
